scope: Codemasters hardware paths in the current patched Genesis Plus GX core and every accessible relevant content in the specified SMS collection.

hardware_model.ROM_slots: Three 16 KiB windows at 0000-3FFF, 4000-7FFF and 8000-BFFF, initially banks 0/1/0. Slot 0 includes the first 1 KiB. Register reads return mapped content, not a latch.
hardware_model.mirrors: The maintained hardware reference documents register aliases throughout each 16 KiB ROM window. A physical Cosmic Spacehead PAL16R4 pinout lacks A0..A13. No separate exact-address prototype decoder was established.
hardware_model.RAM: Bit 7 of writes to 4000 enables 8 KiB RAM at A000-BFFF. Lower 8000-9FFF remains ROM, bank2 changes preserve RAM, and disabling RAM reveals the current ROM bank.
hardware_model.physical_battery: Ernie Els Golf has non-battery-backed RAM, as established by board photographs. It is a GG game absent from this SMS collection. Save-buffer tests do not assert a physical battery.
hardware_model.state: Native state stores four FCR bytes and reconstructs mappings. SRAM contents are separate; application rewind/movie/network wrappers append save memory. The fixture checks native maps and a combined state-plus-save-memory roundtrip.
hardware_model.reset: Reset restores 0/1/0 with RAM disabled while preserving the exposed SRAM buffer. Public save-memory export/import across game reload is verified.
hardware_model.RAM_buffer_offset: The existing implementation maps the 8 KiB region into sram.sram[0x2000..0x3FFF]; the exported size includes this range.

confirmed_gap_and_fix.baseline: write_mapper_codies recognized only exact0000/4000/8000, ignoring hardware aliases.
confirmed_gap_and_fix.fix: Decode the16KiB window using A14/A15. When RAM is enabled, writesA000-BFFF go to RAM instead of bank2; lower-slot2 aliases still select the ROM bank.
confirmed_gap_and_fix.changed_code: write_mapper_codies plus a read-only active-board getter and scoped ABI branches. No RAM layout/native state format change.
confirmed_gap_and_fix.baseline_result: Canonical banking/RAM/state/reset/battery checks passed. Ten alias-related assertions failed.
confirmed_gap_and_fix.fixed_result: All checks pass, including all three slot aliases, full slot0, no Sega-register shadowing, RAM precedence, state, reset and save-memory roundtrip.

cases.name: Go! Dizzy Go!
cases.observed: Both return/restart instead of entering the incomplete minigame; exact resulting video/PCM differs. The broad decoder services noncanonical writes that baseline ignored.

cases.name: Panic Dizzy
cases.observed: Both reach the Panic Dizzy game screen.

prototype_followup.baseline_noncanonical_writes: On the incomplete Go! Dizzy Go! path, writes include8080=FF,6001=91 and016E=FF. The old handler ignored them; the hardware-window decoder services them.
prototype_followup.interpretation: The two functioning menu/game paths preserve complete video/PCM exactly. The incomplete path already fails to enter normal play on baseline. A first-person Maxim technical comment independently identifies one incomplete SMS prototype minigame that resets. No evidence for a separate exact-address decoder board was found; the incomplete ROM was not patched or repaired.
prototype_followup.limitations: No physical prototype board was measured here. Physical pinout evidence is directly for Cosmic Spacehead; the complete three-window model also relies on the maintained primary hardware documentation.

Micro_Machines_conversion.interpretation: 121 little-endian address operands change 0080 to FFFF (bank register8000 to SegaFFFF), plus the two Sega checksum bytes at7FFA. No Codemasters hardware rule is assigned to this conversion. Manual PAL is documented; no new fix database entry is added.

sources.supports: Three slots, mirrored register ranges, initial banks0/1/0, no fixed first1KiB, RAM enable semantics.
Mike G physical Cosmic Spacehead PAL16R4 pinout and discussion showing no address input belowA14.
Original board photographs; Bock2021 identifies Ernie Els Golf8KiB non-battery RAM.
Additional Codemasters header and internal checksum format.
Maxim technical correction on full-slot paging and one incomplete resetting SMS prototype minigame.
Independent implementation comparison only; its exact-address dispatch is not treated as physical hardware proof.

limits: Full playthroughs, all prototype functionality, physical board reverse engineering and external battery hardware claims are outside this bounded audit. No user ROM/settings/saves were changed. The encrypted optional archive was not cracked.

fixture_validation.fixture_generation: Original Z80 program copies itself into work RAM before bank changes. A 32-bit CRC suffix selects the existing Codemasters board entry without any copyrighted game bytes.

region_patch_readonly_review.result: No actionable finding. No additional emulation runs were performed for this review.
region_patch_readonly_review.bounds: Binary search uses [lo,hi), checks lo<count before indexing, and requires exact CRC plus ROM byte size.
region_patch_readonly_review.priority: SMS/SMS2 only; explicit Mark III excluded; Japanese FM exception precedes lookup; non-generic Japanese database region is retained. Manual config.region_detect overrides auto later in loadrom.c.

self_contained_evidence: Fixture observations, expected/observed values, exact hashes, all relevant ROM writes, prototype comparisons and source URLs are embedded here. Scratch traces/screens may be removed after final review; their relative names are provenance labels, not required dependencies.
